Advisor.description: A councillor: hired once, paid every year, and effective by skill (1 to 3).
Advisor.title: Advisor

AgendaSpec.description: A reign's ambition: a deed to do so many times while the ruler reigns.
AgendaSpec.title: AgendaSpec

BuildingSpec.description:
What a building costs and does. The effect text is for humans and prompts; the numbers
behind it live in `Rules` and `mechanics.py`.
BuildingSpec.title: BuildingSpec

ColonialGood.description: What the colonies ship home, sold on Europe's markets at a price of its own.
ColonialGood.title: ColonialGood

Colony.description: One colony of a crown: how it was founded, and when.
Colony.title: Colony

ColonyKind.description: How a colony is founded and worked.
ColonyKind.title: ColonyKind

ColonyKindSpec.description: What each kind of colony costs, how fast it is founded and what it ships.
ColonyKindSpec.title: ColonyKindSpec

CrisisView.description:
The age's great trouble, once it is announced (the year before it falls) and while it
rages. Its effects are in the realm's modifiers and the market.
CrisisView.title: CrisisView

DecisionView.description: One of your crown's national decisions: `take_decision` it once its goals hold.
DecisionView.title: DecisionView

DesignationSpec.description:
What a focused province becomes as it builds what its focus needs: a designation in
three tiers. The focus alone is tier 1; one of its key works makes tier 2 (one more building
slot); two make tier 3, with a landmark of its own, a bonus to the realm's provinces next to
it and an effect felt across the realm (from no more than rules.designation_realm_cap of a
kind).
DesignationSpec.title: DesignationSpec

Expedition.description: Settlers and soldiers on their way to found a colony.
Expedition.title: Expedition

Focus.description:
What a province's people turn their hands to. A focus strengthens one side of its
output, the more the larger its town.
Focus.title: Focus

Good.description:
What a province is known for, on top of its base output. Each yields its own mix of
resources by development (see `Rules.good_yields`): gold far more than grain.
Good.title: Good

GoodSpec.description:
A colonial good's price: its base, falling as the crowns ship more of it than Europe
wants (its glut), never below a floor; silver also feeds the inflation of whoever ships it.
GoodSpec.title: GoodSpec

GrudgeView.description: A wrong one court holds against another, and how long it will weigh.
GrudgeView.title: GrudgeView

Modifiers.description: Everything that makes this nation different from a blank one.
Modifiers.title: Modifiers

MonumentSpec.description:
A great building of its age, standing in one province: whoever holds the province enjoys
it, and can raise it level by level (0 is a site where it is not yet built).
MonumentSpec.title: MonumentSpec

NationalUnit.description:
The regiments a crown was famed for: one kind of its army fights under its own name, and
better (and sometimes for less) than anyone else's of that kind.
NationalUnit.title: NationalUnit

Personality.description: How an advisor leans when counselling the crown.
Personality.title: Personality

PolicyAxis.description: A great choice of how the realm is run: one side or the other, or neither.
PolicyAxis.title: PolicyAxis

Posture.description: How a province's garrison waits for an attack.
Posture.title: Posture

Region.description:
The lands beyond the sea that crowns may colonise: not on the map, but in the menu of
the New World.
Region.title: Region

RegionSpec.description: What a region beyond the sea offers, and how hard it is to hold.
RegionSpec.title: RegionSpec

RegionView.description: A region beyond the sea, as the chart of the New World shows it.
RegionView.title: RegionView

Resources.description: A bundle of the six national resources. Never negative.
Resources.title: Resources

RoyalAct.description: What a crown can do by its own authority (see Rules.royal_acts).
RoyalAct.title: RoyalAct

Ruler.description: The crowned head of a nation. Ages one year a turn, and one day dies.
Ruler.title: Ruler

Rules.description: Every number the engine uses. Part of the state so a tournament can vary them.

peace_cost_per_year_of_income.title: Peace Cost Per Year Of Income

Rules.title: Rules

SeaView.description: A zone of the sea, with every fleet in it (navies are public).
SeaView.title: SeaView

Settlement.description:
What a province's chief town has grown into: from a hamlet to a great city. Development
decides it, and it decides how many works the province has room for.
Settlement.title: Settlement

ShipSpec.description: What a kind of ship costs and is worth in each water.
ShipSpec.title: ShipSpec

Stance.description: A court's declared attitude towards another, public to all Europe.
Stance.title: Stance

TechLevel.description:
One step of a technology branch: what it is called, what it brings, what it needs from
another branch, and the doctrines to choose between when it is reached.
TechLevel.title: TechLevel

TechOption.description: One of the doctrines a level offers: choosing it shuts the others out for good.
TechOption.title: TechOption

TradeView.description: A crown's trade in one colonial good.
TradeView.title: TradeView

Trait.description:
A ruler's character. Some move the numbers a little; all of them tell an AI ruler (and a
reader) who this person is.
Trait.title: Trait

UnitSpec.description:
One kind of regiment: what it costs, what it eats and how it fights. A regiment's strength
is its attack (or defence) times the terrain it fights on.
UnitSpec.title: UnitSpec

Viceroy.description: The crown's viceroy over a region where it holds a viceroyalty.
Viceroy.title: Viceroy

Water.description: The three waters a fleet can hold. Every coastal province looks onto one or two.
Water.title: Water
